analysis: Both supplied units are BASE-side text of docs/provider/cli-reference.md (lines 1983-2816). The PR's changed ranges fall mostly outside these lines. The only visible patch hunks are at head lines 182 and 191: the `sandbox` command row now says `setup` requires approval from a Darkbloom Sandbox waitlist, linked to `#darkbloom-waitlist`. The rest of the patch is truncated, and the head ranges 1360-1385 and 1635-1727 are not visible. The base lines I examined are unchanged context: status and doctor diagnostics, models download/location, update, beta, fan, login/logout, unenroll, report, the exit-code table and the paths table. The paths table includes the add-on runtime row with `addon.sock` 0600 and `addon-hold.json`, and the Darkbloom Sandbox add-on row, which concern TB-012, TB-013 and T-061. Nothing in this batch alters a security control. This is documentation only, and I found no code, authorization, attestation, encryption or billing change. The prefix-cache statements (T-041) and the paths table do not contradict the threat model. The new waitlist-approval gate on `sandbox setup` is a documented product requirement. Whether the CLI or the sandbox service enforces it, and whether it affects T-061's installer download-and-run trust, is not evidenced here. The truncated hunks at head 1360-1385 and 1635-1727 might add waitlist or sandbox behavior, such as an approval check or token handling. These need review in any batch that contains them. I make no claim that the whole PR is safe.
